components.name: Accordion
components.description:
Tenet accordion — stacked disclosure sections. Each item is a header `<button aria-expanded>`
controlling a labelled region. `type="single"` keeps one open (collapsible), `multiple` allows
many. Headers are arrow-key navigable (Up/Down/Home/End). Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: type
props.description: `single` allows one open item (collapsible); `multiple` allows many.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled set of open item values.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open item values.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new set of open values.

components.name: Avatar
components.description:
Tenet avatar — an image, or initials derived from `name` when there is no image (or it fails to
load). Always pass `name`: it drives the initials and the accessible label, so an avatar is never
an unlabelled blob to assistive tech.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. When omitted (or it fails to load), initials from `name` are shown.

props.name: name
props.description: Person/entity name — used for initials and as the accessible label.

props.name: size
props.description: Size from the scale.

props.name: shape
props.description: Circle (people) or rounded square (orgs/repos).

components.name: Badge
components.description:
Tenet badge — a small count or status dot, typically anchored to an icon or nav item. Use it for
quantities ("3 unread") or presence dots. For a labelled status word (passing/failing) use
`Label` instead.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic color scheme.

props.name: count
props.description: Numeric count. Rendered with a `max+` overflow when above `max`.

props.name: max
props.description: Overflow threshold for `count` (e.g. 99 -> "99+").

props.name: dot
props.description: Render a bare status dot (no text).

props.name: children
props.description: Custom content (overrides count).

components.name: Banner
components.description:
Tenet banner — an inline, contextual message tied to the content it sits near (form error,
page-level notice). Colors come from the semantic tint tokens. For transient, floating messages
use a toast instead; for a status word on a row, use `Label`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic tone. Pick by meaning, not color.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional bold lead-in line.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replace the default leading icon.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hide the leading icon entirely.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: When provided, renders a dismiss button that calls this.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description:
Tenet breadcrumbs — the path from the root to the current page. Renders a `<nav>` landmark with
an ordered list; the last item is the current page (`aria-current="page"`, not a link). Pass an
`aria-label` so multiple navs on a page are distinguishable.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered trail, root first. The last item is treated as the current page.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

props.name: separator
props.description: Separator glyph between items.

components.name: Button
components.description:
Tenet action button. Use `variant="primary"` for the single most important action on a
surface, `default` for secondary actions, `invisible` for tertiary, and `danger` for
destructive actions. All styling comes from design tokens — never hardcode colors or spacing.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button. Use `primary` for the single most important action per surface.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height / padding scale.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered after the label.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the button to fill the available width.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch the button to fill the available width.
props.deprecated: Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

components.name: Calendar
components.description:
Tenet calendar — a month-grid date picker surface. Full keyboard support (arrows move by day/
week, Home/End jump within the week, PageUp/PageDown change month, Enter/Space select), a roving
tab stop, and the ARIA grid pattern. Use it inline, or let `DatePicker` host it in a popover.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date (null = nothing selected).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected date.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen date.

props.name: month
props.description: Controlled visible month (any day within the month).

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Uncontrolled initial visible month. Defaults to the selected date's month, else today.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called when the visible month changes (nav buttons / keyboard paging).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable day (inclusive).

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable day (inclusive).

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday (default), 1 = Monday.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month / weekday formatting. Defaults to the runtime locale.

components.name: Card
components.description:
Tenet surface container — a bordered, rounded panel for grouping content (the design-system
way to make a "box"). Border, radius, background and elevation all come from tokens; never
hand-roll a styled `<div>` with hardcoded border/shadow values.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface style. `default` sits on the page; `muted` is a recessed/secondary surface.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding, from the `space` scale.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
Tenet checkbox. A real `<input type="checkbox">` tinted with the accent token, with an
associated label and optional caption — use it instead of a styled `<div>` toggle. Supports an
`indeterminate` (mixed) state for "select all" parents.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label rendered next to the box.

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional helper text under the label.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark the field as invalid (sets `aria-invalid`).

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Tri-state "partially checked" visual (mixed); also sets `aria-checked="mixed"`.

components.name: DataTable
components.description:
Tenet data table. A higher-level table driven by `columns` + `data`: optional global search,
per-column dropdown filters, and client-side sort — all built on the `Table` primitives and
the `TextInput` / `Select` fields, so it stays on-system. For a fully custom layout, drop down
to `Table.*` directly.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions, left to right.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows to render.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Stable React key for a row. Defaults to the row index.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show the global search box.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the global search box.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional surface title (rendered in a `Table.Container`).

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Optional surface subtitle.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions rendered at the top-right of the toolbar (e.g. a "New" button).

props.name: density
props.description: Row height / cell padding scale.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Message shown when no rows match the active filters.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description:
Tenet date picker — a token-styled field that opens a `Calendar` popover. Selecting a day (mouse
or keyboard) commits the value and closes the menu; Escape closes; clicking outside closes. The
trigger carries the ARIA combobox/dialog wiring, the Calendar carries the grid + keyboard model.
Controlled or uncontrolled, FormControl-compatible, and emits a hidden yyyy-mm-dd input when
given a `name`. Always give it an accessible name via FormControl or `aria-label`.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date (null = empty).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected date.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen date.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable day (inclusive).

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable day (inclusive).

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday (default), 1 = Monday.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for the displayed date + calendar. Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown in the trigger when no date is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height / font scale.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the trigger to fill the available width.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch the trigger to fill the available width.
props.deprecated: Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid state (danger border + aria-invalid).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the control.

props.name: required
props.description: Required (sets aria-required; pairs with FormControl).

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — emits a hidden input (yyyy-mm-dd) so the value submits with a form.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the trigger (FormControl sets this automatically).

components.name: Dialog
components.description:
Tenet dialog — a modal overlay rendered in a portal. Handles the things hand-rolled modals get
wrong: focus moves in on open and is restored on close, Tab is trapped inside, Escape and the
backdrop close it, body scroll is locked, and it's wired as `role="dialog" aria-modal` with the
title/description as its accessible name. Reach for it for focused tasks and confirmations.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user requests close (Escape, backdrop, close button).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title — also the visible heading.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting description under the title.

props.name: size
props.description: Width from the scale.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer actions (e.g. Cancel / Confirm buttons).

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Allow closing by clicking the backdrop.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

components.name: Divider
components.description:
Tenet divider — a hairline separator. Vertical or horizontal; horizontal optionally carries a
centered label ("OR"). Exposes `role="separator"` with the right orientation so it's a real
landmark, not a styled border.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional centered label (horizontal only).

components.name: EmptyState
components.description:
Tenet empty state — what a table, list, search or inbox shows when it has nothing to show. A centered
headline, an optional explanation, a decorative icon and up to two next-step actions, composed from
`Heading`, `Text` and `Stack`. Use it instead of an improvised centered `<div>`; keep the title
specific ("No results for 'budget'") and make `action` the one thing that fixes the emptiness.
`headingLevel` sets the title's rank in the outline; its visual size follows `size`.

props.name: title
props.description: Short, specific headline — say what is empty ("No stories yet"), not just "Nothing here".

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences: why it is empty and what to do next. Inline content (rendered in a muted `Text`).

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative illustration or icon; wrapped `aria-hidden` — the title carries the meaning.

props.name: action
props.description: The primary next step, usually a `Button variant="primary"`.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: An optional secondary step next to `action` (a default/invisible `Button` or a `Link`).

props.name: size
props.description: Overall scale: `medium` for a region inside a page, `large` for a whole-page/first-run state.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description:
Semantic heading rank of the title (`h2`/`h3`/`h4`) so it fits the surrounding outline. The visual
size follows `size`, not this prop.

props.name: id
props.description: Override the generated id shared by the label and field.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required (asterisk on the label + `required` on the input).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Force the invalid state. Otherwise inferred from a `FormControl.Validation variant="error"`.

subcomponents.name: FormControl.Label

props.name: visuallyHidden
props.description: Visually hide the label but keep it for screen readers.

props.name: required
props.description: Injected by FormControl — renders the required asterisk.

subcomponents.description: Field label. Rendered by FormControl with `htmlFor` + required state wired automatically.

subcomponents.name: FormControl.Caption
subcomponents.description: Helper text below the field, associated via `aria-describedby`.

subcomponents.name: FormControl.Validation

props.name: variant
props.description: Tone of the message. `error` also drives the field's invalid state.

subcomponents.description: Validation message. `variant="error"` also flips the field to its invalid state.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Number of equal-width columns, either fixed or per breakpoint, e.g. `{ base: 1, sm: 2, lg: 4 }`.
Each column is `minmax(0, 1fr)` so long content can't blow the track out.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between rows and columns, from the `space` scale (condensed=8, normal=16, spacious=24).

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Overrides the row spacing only, from the same scale; defaults to `gap`.

props.name: align
props.description: Block-axis alignment of items within their row (maps to `align-items`).

props.name: span
props.description: Number of columns this item spans (`grid-column: span N`), fixed or per breakpoint.

components.name: Heading
components.description:
Tenet heading — the display (serif) type scale with correct document semantics. `level` drives the
SIZE and the default element; `as` overrides the ELEMENT when semantics and size must differ (one
`h1` per page, then `h2`… in order — pick the look with `level`, never skip heading ranks for looks).
Use this instead of a raw `<h1 style={…}>`; body copy belongs in `Text`.

props.name: level
props.description:
Visual size on the type scale: 1 → `fontSize-5` (36), 2 → `fontSize-4` (28), 3 → `fontSize-3` (20),
4 → `fontSize-2` (16). Also picks the default element (`h1`…`h4`).

props.name: as
props.description:
Element to render, so document semantics and visual size can differ (e.g. a level-1 look on an `h2`
in a page that already has an `h1`).

props.name: truncate
props.description: Clip overflowing text to a single line with an ellipsis.

props.name: children
props.description: Heading text.

components.name: Icon
components.description:
Tenet icon primitive — the `<svg>` shell every glyph in `tenet-ui/icons` renders through. It fixes
the geometry (24×24 grid scaled to `size`), the Lucide stroke style (`currentColor`, round caps and
joins, stroke width 2) and the accessibility default: decorative (`aria-hidden`) unless you pass a
`label`, in which case it becomes `role="img"` with that name.

Prefer the named glyphs (`<SearchIcon />`) over composing `Icon` directly; reach for `Icon` only to
wrap a one-off glyph that is not yet in the set. Color is inherited from the parent's `color`, so
icons follow the token the surrounding text uses.

Stroke width is a constant 2 (Lucide's native weight) rather than thinned per size: the glyphs were
drawn for it, it scales optically with `size` (1.33px at 16, 2px at 24) and it matches what designers
see in Lucide's Figma library. Override `strokeWidth` per instance if a surface truly needs lighter.

props.name: size
props.description:
Rendered width and height in pixels. `16` sits on the text line inside controls (Button,
IconButton, inputs); `20` for large controls and list rows; `24` for empty states, page headers
and stat tiles.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name. Set it ONLY when the icon carries meaning on its own (no adjacent text names
it). When set the SVG gets `role="img"` and `aria-label`; when absent the icon is decorative
(`aria-hidden="true"`) and the surrounding control must carry the name.

props.name: children
props.description:
The glyph: SVG shape nodes (`<path>`, `<circle>`, …) drawn on Lucide's 24×24 grid. Consumers
normally render a named glyph from `tenet-ui/icons` (`<SearchIcon />`) which supplies this.

components.name: IconButton
components.description:
Tenet icon-only button — a square control whose only visible content is an icon. Use it for
compact actions in toolbars, table rows, and dialog corners where a text label won't fit. For
anything with room for a label, prefer `Button` (a labelled button is always clearer).

Because there is no visible text, an IconButton MUST be given an accessible name via `aria-label`
(or `aria-labelledby`) — otherwise screen-reader users hear nothing. The icon itself is rendered
`aria-hidden`, so the name has to come from the prop.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon to render. This is the only visible content, so the button must also have an accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button. Use `primary` for the single most important action per surface.

props.name: size
props.description: Square control size (height = width), mapped to the control-height tokens.

components.name: Label
components.description:
Tenet status label / pill. Choose a `variant` by meaning (success, danger, accent) — the colors
are owned by the design system, so consumers never compute their own fills or borders. This is
the on-system replacement for a hand-styled `<span>` with hardcoded translucent colors.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic color scheme. Pick by meaning (success/danger/accent), not by raw color.

props.name: size
props.description: Label size.

components.name: Link
components.description:
Tenet link — an inline navigational anchor. Renders a real `<a>` (forwards its ref) so it keeps
native keyboard + activation behavior; style it with `muted` and `underline` instead of writing
raw anchor CSS. Always give it meaningful link text (not "click here"). For an off-site link pass
`external` so it opens in a new tab AND warns screen-reader users it does so.

props.name: muted
props.description: Use the muted foreground color instead of the accent color.

props.name: underline
props.description: When the underline is shown.

props.name: external
props.description:
Marks the link as leading off-site: sets `target="_blank"` +
`rel="noopener noreferrer"` and appends a visually-hidden " (opens in new tab)"
warning for screen-reader users.

components.name: Menu
components.description:
Tenet action menu — a button that opens a popover list of actions (ARIA menu pattern). Arrow keys
move, Enter/Space invoke, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger, click-outside closes.
Items run their `onSelect` and the menu closes. Distinct from `Select`, which picks a value.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger element (e.g. a Button). It is wired with the menu's aria + click handling.

props.name: items
props.description: The actions to show.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the menu.

props.name: align
props.description: Menu alignment relative to the trigger.

components.name: NumberInput
components.description:
Tenet number field. A text input constrained to numbers, with +/- steppers and arrow-key
stepping that respect `min` / `max` / `step`. Reports a parsed `number | null` (not a string)
via `onChange`, so callers never re-parse. Always give it an accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Use `null`/`undefined` for an empty field.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the parsed numeric value (or `null` when the field is cleared).

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest allowed value. Stepping/clamping respects it.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest allowed value. Stepping/clamping respects it.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment applied by the steppers and arrow keys.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height / font scale.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the field to fill the available width.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch the field to fill the available width.
props.deprecated: Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark the field as invalid (sets `aria-invalid` and a danger border).

components.name: Pagination
components.description:
Tenet pagination — navigate a paged result set. Renders a `<nav>` landmark of real `<button>`s
(keyboard-operable by construction), marks the current page with `aria-current="page"`, and
disables Previous/Next at the ends. Long ranges collapse with ellipses around a window of pages.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page (1-based).

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the requested page when the user navigates.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: How many page numbers to show around the current page.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

components.name: Popover
components.description:
Tenet popover — a generic floating container anchored to a trigger (the ARIA non-modal dialog
pattern). On open, focus moves into the surface; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger;
clicking outside closes; and focus leaving the wrapper (Tab-out) closes it so it can't strand
open behind the page. This is **non-modal**: it does not trap focus, lock scroll, or hide the
background — reach for `Dialog` when you need those. Always give it an accessible name via
`aria-label`.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
The trigger element (e.g. a Button). It is cloned and wired with
`aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, an onClick toggle,
and a ref so focus can be restored to it on close.

props.name: children
props.description: The floating content rendered inside the popover surface.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the surface is anchored relative to the trigger.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the popover dialog (falls back to "Popover").

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description:
Tenet progress bar — a `role="progressbar"` feedback indicator for the progress of a task.

Determinate (a `value` is given): shows a fixed fill and reports `aria-valuenow` plus a readable
`aria-valuetext` (e.g. "42%"). Omit `value` for an INDETERMINATE bar (unknown duration) that runs
an animated sweep and omits `aria-valuenow`.

The one rule people get wrong: a progressbar has no inherent label, so you MUST pass an accessible
name via `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` — otherwise screen readers announce it nameless.

props.name: value
props.description:
Current progress, from 0 to `max`. Values are clamped into range.
Omit (or pass `undefined`) for an INDETERMINATE bar that shows an
animated sweep instead of a fixed fill.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound of the scale. Defaults to 100.

props.name: size
props.description: Track/fill height from the size scale. Defaults to 'medium'.

props.name: variant
props.description: Fill color, mapped to the matching emphasis token. Defaults to 'accent'.

components.name: Radio
components.description:
Tenet radio. A real `<input type="radio">` tinted with the accent token. Use inside a
`RadioGroup`, which wires the shared `name` and selection for you.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted when this radio is selected (required).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label rendered next to the control.

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional helper text under the label.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description:
Tenet radio group. Renders a `<fieldset>`/`<legend>` and shares `name` + selection with its
`Radio` children via context — so grouping and accessibility are correct without prop drilling.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared form field name. Auto-generated if omitted.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label (rendered as a fieldset legend).

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional helper text for the whole group.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value.

props.name: required
props.description: Mark the group required (asterisk on the legend).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every radio in the group.

props.name: children
props.description: Radio children.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description:
Tenet segmented control — a compact single-choice switch between a few options (a view toggle,
a filter mode). Implemented as an ARIA radiogroup: arrow keys move and select (selection follows
focus), with a roving tab stop. For many options or free text use `Select`; for on/off use `Switch`.

props.name: options
props.description: The segments to choose from.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height / font scale.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch segments to fill the available width.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch segments to fill the available width.
props.deprecated: Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group (required for screen readers).

components.name: Select
components.description:
Tenet select — a real ARIA listbox combobox (not a native `<select>`). Styled menu, full
keyboard support (↑/↓/Home/End/Enter/Esc), typeahead, `aria-activedescendant`, click-outside,
controlled or uncontrolled. Token-styled, theme-aware, and FormControl-compatible. Always give
it an accessible name via FormControl or `aria-label`.

props.name: options
props.description: The options to choose from.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when nothing is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height / font scale.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the available width.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to fill the available width.
props.deprecated: Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid state (danger border + aria-invalid).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the control.

props.name: required
props.description: Required (sets aria-required; pairs with FormControl).

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — emits a hidden input so the value submits with a form.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the trigger (FormControl sets this automatically).

components.name: Skeleton
components.description:
Tenet skeleton — a decorative loading placeholder that shimmers while content streams in.
It is `aria-hidden`: announce the wait on the surrounding region with `aria-busy="true"`
(and a visually-hidden status / Spinner label), not on each skeleton block.
Use `text` for lines of copy, `circle` for an avatar, `rect` for a media/card block.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the placeholder. `text` mimics a line of copy, `rect` a block, `circle` an avatar/icon.

props.name: width
props.description: Width applied inline (number → px, string → as-is, e.g. '60%').

props.name: height
props.description: Height applied inline (number → px, string → as-is). For `circle` it mirrors width.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius token. `circle` always renders as `full` regardless of this prop.

components.name: Spinner
components.description:
Tenet spinner — an indeterminate loading indicator. Renders `role="status"` with a visually
hidden label so screen readers announce the loading state. Inherits `currentColor`, so it tints
to whatever text color it sits in.

props.name: size
props.description: Size from the scale.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label announced to assistive tech (visually hidden).

props.name: direction
props.description: Main-axis direction.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, from the `space` scale (condensed=8, normal=16, spacious=24).

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment (maps to `align-items`).

props.name: justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution (maps to `justify-content`).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Allow children to wrap onto multiple lines.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding, from the `space` scale.

props.name: grow
props.description: Grow to fill the available space along the main axis.

components.name: Switch
components.description:
Tenet switch. A real `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` styled as a sliding toggle —
use it for an immediate on/off setting (not for a value you submit on a separate save).
Keyboard + screen-reader behaviour comes from the native input; the track/knob are CSS.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label rendered next to the switch.

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional helper text under the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Control track / knob scale.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark the field as invalid (sets `aria-invalid` and a danger border).

props.name: density
props.description: Row height / cell padding scale.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment within the header cell.

props.name: sortDirection
props.description: When set, renders a sort indicator and exposes `aria-sort`. Combine with `onClick`.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment within the cell.

components.name: Tabs
components.description:
Tenet tabs — a controlled or uncontrolled tab set following the ARIA tabs pattern. Compose
`Tabs.List` + `Tabs.Tab` with matching `Tabs.Panel`s. Arrow keys move between tabs (selection
follows focus), Home/End jump to the ends; roles, ids and `aria-controls`/`aria-labelledby` are
wired for you.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active tab value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial active tab value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the active tab changes.

components.name: Tag
components.description:
Tenet Tag — the system's pill. Without `onRemove` it is a read-only word attached to an item
(a status such as "Published", a category, a keyword) coloured by `variant`. With `onRemove` it
becomes a removable chip for user-applied tokens (active filters, selected recipients). For a
count or presence dot use `Badge`. (Replaces the deprecated `Label` since 0.4.0.)

The one rule people get wrong: Tag is stateless. Setting `onRemove` renders a real <button>, but
the parent owns the collection — your handler must drop the item, Tag won't remove itself.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Semantic color scheme. Pick by meaning, never by raw color: `accent` for an active/selected token,
`success` / `danger` / `attention` for status words, `muted` for a quiet neutral, `default` otherwise.

props.name: size
props.description: Tag size.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Optional leading icon rendered before the label; decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: children
props.description: The tag label content.

props.name: onRemove
props.description:
When provided, renders a real remove button. Wire it to drop the tag from your collection.
Tag does not remove itself — it has no internal state.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description:
Accessible label for the remove button when `children` is not a plain string.
Falls back to the string children, otherwise "Remove".

components.name: Text
components.description:
Tenet body copy — paragraphs, captions, helper text and status messages on the body (sans) scale. `size` picks the scale step, `tone` the semantic color (`muted` for secondary copy, status tones for messages). Use it instead of a `

`; titles belong in `Heading`. Don't convey a status by color alone — pair a `danger`/`success` tone with words or an icon.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render.

props.name: size
props.description: Size on the body type scale (small=12, medium=14, large=16).

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color: `muted` for secondary copy, status tones for validation and state messages.

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Clip overflowing text to a single line with an ellipsis.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal text alignment (logical: `start`/`end` follow writing direction).

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Associates the text with a form control; only meaningful with `as="label"`.

props.name: children
props.description: Text content.

components.name: Textarea
components.description:
Tenet multi-line text field. A real, accessible `<textarea>` with token-based chrome — use it
instead of a raw `<textarea>`. Always give it an accessible name via FormControl or `aria-label`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the available width.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to fill the available width.
props.deprecated: Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark the field invalid (sets aria-invalid and a danger border).

props.name: resize
props.description: Which directions the user may resize.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding / font scale — matches TextInput so fields line up in a form.

components.name: TextInput
components.description:
Tenet text field. Renders a real, accessible `<input>` wrapped with token-based chrome —
use this instead of a raw `<input>` so border, height, spacing and focus styling stay on-system.
Always pass an accessible name via `aria-label` or an associated `<label>`.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height / font scale.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the field to fill the available width.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch the field to fill the available width.
props.deprecated: Use `fullWidth` instead (renamed in 0.4.0). `block` keeps working until 0.5.0.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Element rendered before the input (e.g. a search icon).

props.name: trailingVisual
props.description: Element rendered after the input.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark the field as invalid (sets `aria-invalid` and a danger border).

components.name: ToastProvider
components.description:
Tenet toast provider — mounts a portalled, live-region viewport and exposes `useToast()` to any
descendant. Toasts auto-dismiss (configurable), can be dismissed manually, and are announced to
assistive tech (danger = assertive alert, others = polite status). Use toasts for transient,
non-blocking feedback; for inline contextual messages use `Banner`, for blocking flows `Dialog`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss duration (ms) when an individual toast doesn't set one.

props.name: placement
props.description: Viewport corner.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description:
Tenet tooltip — a small text hint shown on hover and on keyboard focus (not hover-only, so it's
reachable without a mouse). The trigger is described by the tooltip via `aria-describedby` (merged
with any the caller already set, not replaced); the bubble stays mounted so that association is
always valid. The bubble renders in a portal and is positioned to the viewport, so it can't be
clipped by an `overflow:hidden` ancestor or run off the screen near an edge. The trigger must be a
single focusable element. Never put essential-only info in a tooltip.

props.name: content
props.description: Tooltip text/content.

props.name: placement
props.description: Side of the trigger to render on.

props.name: children
props.description: The single trigger element (must be focusable for keyboard users).

components.name: useToast
